name: CampusMate
problem: Important event information is spread across posters and announcements.
solution: A prototype that turns an event poster into a concise explanation and an audio invitation.
facts: Accepts an uploaded poster image; no live-camera or mobile-app feature is claimed.
Uses Step 5 Preview to understand visible information.
Can generate a spoken invitation using StepAudio.
This is a workshop demo brief, not a claim about a launched product.
No creator background, customers, or measured speed improvements are established.
